page_title: BAY 3-0 UNI | Bayern Munich v Union Berlin 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+2' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
90+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A lofted cross from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

88' What a wasted opportunity by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow makes an astonishing save to thwart him.

86' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
85' Bayern Munich are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will take a throw-in.
84' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Rani Khedira (Union Berlin), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
82' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' Bayern Munich show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. Bayern Munich have a corner.
80' Bo Svensson has decided to make a change. Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) replaces Kevin Vogt.
80' Substitution. Alphonso Davies walks off the pitch and Adam Aznou (Bayern Munich) comes on as a substitute.
80' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

77' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayern Munich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
76' The possession of the ball – 76:24.
74' Substitution. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jamal Musiala walks off.

73' What a chance that is! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

70' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the left side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Frederik Ronnow, who keeps it out.
69' Today's match ends for Woo-Yeong Jeong who will be replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
69' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aljoscha Kemlein.
69' It's time for a substitution. Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Joao Palhinha.
69' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Michael Olise and he is replaced by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich).
69' The substitution is prepared. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Min-Jae Kim.

68' Bayern Munich slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
66' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Union Berlin win a corner.
64' 4:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
63' Bayern Munich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

62' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.
60' Bo Svensson has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) replacing Jordan Siebatcheu.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Benedict Hollerbach walks off the pitch to be replaced by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
57' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
56' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

55' Bayern Munich are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes wild in celebration.
52' Wait! Referee Matthias Jollenbeck has indicated he is going to review the Bayern Munich goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
51' 3 - 0 Goal! Kingsley Coman gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 3:0.
50' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
49' The referee awards a corner and Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes over to take it.
48' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) unleashes a shot from long range but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.
47' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
46' The whistle blows and Matthias Jollenbeck starts the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 0 Goal! Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Harry Kane, then sends the ball into the roof of the net. 2:0.
42' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
40' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
40' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

38' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Bayern Munich, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

36' A clever short pass gives Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
35' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
34' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Corner kick. Union Berlin will have an opportunity.

33' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the roof of the net, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Manuel Neuer. What a save! The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.
31' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Matthias Jollenbeck didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
30' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
27' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Frederik Ronnow is alert and denies him.
26' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
24' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matthias Jollenbeck no option but to blow his whistle.
22' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.

19' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
17' Bayern Munich showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a throw-in.
15' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Frederik Ronnow no chance!
15' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

14' A player from Union Berlin pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from Bayern Munich is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
13' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

13' That's unlucky! Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
11' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
9' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
8' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

6' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayern Munich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
4' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) will deliver the corner kick.
4' Union Berlin keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
